decision.reasoning: The customer is reporting two distinct issues simultaneously — a wrong item shipped (shipping/product defect) and an overcharge for the incorrect item (billing). The billing aspect takes priority since there is a direct financial discrepancy: the customer paid Pro 500 price of $149.99 but received a Basic 200. Additionally they need overnight reshipping which suggests time pressure. Customer history and similar past complaints were consulted to calibrate priority and understand the resolution path. The operator needs the full context before responding.
decision.why: Dual issue with direct overcharge and wrong product shipped — P1 billing takes precedence, full history review needed.
